title: DCLab Code's Rewind read as the person's rejection of the changes since a message
request: Run longer live tests with the remaining budget (a bigger real task, Opus, a long multi-turn session), cap each run, and report.
plan: Read the rewind record DCLab Code's live run built
Treat it as an undo of the changes since its message
Test the cut, the real path and a script's rewind

decisions.decision: A rewind judges only the changes since its message; earlier changes stay waiting
decisions.why: the files go back to before that message, so only its turn and later turns are rejected

decisions.decision: The verdict is rewound, apart from undone
decisions.why: a whole-turn rejection and a per-file undo are different acts; both score 0

decisions.decision: /private plus the root counts as the root
decisions.why: the SDK names a rewound file by its real path

change: sets/dclab_code.py: message uuids mapped to their place; rewind records become undos with since; file_verdicts splits pending changes at since; _rel() shared with _edit; person:rewind in the M6 episode; M7 score 0 for rewound.

measurements.name: store tests
measurements.gate: every DCLab Code set test passes; the since cut, the real path and the script check each fail the new test when removed
limits: invented sessions; no real rewind has reached the store yet

outcome: A Rewind in DCLab Code becomes M7 change judgements (rewound) and a person step in M6.
lessons: When the app gains a new person act, the store reads it in the same day, or the act is lost as training data
risks: a rewind does not restore files changed by shell commands; those changes keep no verdict
